title: Code-world edit: a crossing car turns left instead of going straight
subtitle: Lyft Level 5, Palo Alto, daytime · 25 s at 5 Hz, canvas at 12 Hz · single agent session (Claude Opus 5.5)
task: Edit the scenario in code: a crossing car turns left into the ego's road instead of driving straight through the junction.

steps.label: Plan
steps.text: The edit must change which road one oncoming or crossing vehicle takes at a junction, remain physically plausible, and be clearly visible from the ego camera within the first 185 rendered frames (keyframes 0 to ~76). Procedure: (1) screen the 16 candidate scenes by their real frames and a bird's-eye view (BEV) of all tracks over the map lines; (2) select a vehicle and a manoeuvre that the road layout supports; (3) write the edit in the code world and verify it with `sanity.py` (gaps to all agents and the ego, drivable-area fraction, divider crossings, visibility); (4) render the original and edited conditioning canvases and BEVs with `make_case.py` and inspect them.

steps.label: Edit v1: pocket, left turn, straight exit

# SAW: pocket centre x = 22.7; eastbound lane centre ~ +1.0

# 1. keep the recorded route up to kf 11 (y ~ 48)
car = scene.agent('e74eb685...')
T0 = 11
x0, y0, z0, _ = car.state(T0)
s0, v0 = car._s(T0), car.speed(T0)
POCKET_X, LANE_Y, R = 22.7, 1.0, 13.0

# 2. cosine S-shift into the pocket, quarter circle, then
#    straight east along y = LANE_Y
path = [p for p in car.route if p[1] > y0 + 0.5] + ...
path.append((POCKET_X + R + 200.0, LANE_Y, z0))
car.reroute(path)

# 3. speed: cosine blend v0 -> 6 m/s before the arc,
#    6 m/s on the arc, 6 -> 12 m/s over 35 m after it
car.timing = timing   # integrated v_of(s) at 5 Hz
car.frame_attrs = [((0, 125), {'lyft_category': 'car'})]

steps.label: Edit v2: follow the ego's lane after the turn
steps.code:
# SAW: overlap with 1e1299 at frame 246; 1.0 m clearance
#      to the waiting car 5ef3ef at frame 144

# 1. take the exit lane from the ego's own later path,
#    0.4 m to its right, instead of a straight line
lane = [(e[0], e[1] - 0.4)
        for e in (scene.ego[t] for t in range(60, 126))
        if e[0] > 36.0]
LANE_Y = lane[0][1]
y_arc = LANE_Y + R

# 2. same S-shift and arc; then the lane points and a
#    100 m extension along the final lane direction
path += [(x, y, z0) for x, y in lane[1:]]
(xa, ya), (xb, yb) = lane[-6], lane[-1]
path.append((xb + 100.0,
             yb + 100.0 * (yb - ya) / (xb - xa), z0))
car.reroute(path)
#    -> sanity.py --edited v2/scene_world.py

steps.label: sanity.py: no overlap, on road
steps.text: No overlap with any agent or the ego; the car stays on the drivable area in every frame and crosses only the lane divider into the pocket (12 Hz frame 37). The closest approaches are 1.38 m to the through-lane car `1a7811` while the turn begins (frame 86) and 1.30 m to the oncoming `1e1299` at frame 244, outside the model window. Speed varies smoothly between 10.4 and 6 m/s (acceleration between -1.7 and +2.5 m/s^2); the heading rate peaks at v/R = 0.46 rad/s on the arc.

steps.code:
# code-world edit: detour_other (appended to scene_world.py)
car = scene.agent('e74eb685...')
T0 = 11
x0, y0, z0, _ = car.state(T0)
s0, v0 = car._s(T0), car.speed(T0)
POCKET_X, R, V_TURN, V_OUT = 22.7, 13.0, 6.0, 12.0
lane = [(e[0], e[1] - 0.4)
        for e in (scene.ego[t] for t in range(60, 126))
        if e[0] > 36.0]
LANE_Y = lane[0][1]
y_arc = LANE_Y + R
keep = [p for p in car.route if p[1] > y0 + 0.5]
path = keep + [(x0, y0, z0)]
for i in range(1, 25):        # cosine S-shift into the pocket
    u = i / 24
    w = 0.5 - 0.5 * math.cos(math.pi * u)   # inlined in the file
    path.append((x0 + (POCKET_X - x0) * w,
                 y0 + (24.0 - y0) * u, z0))
path.append((POCKET_X, y_arc, z0))
for i in range(1, 19):        # quarter circle, radius R
    a = math.radians(5 * i)
    path.append((POCKET_X + R - R * math.cos(a),
                 y_arc - R * math.sin(a), z0))
path += [(x, y, z0) for x, y in lane[1:]]
(xa, ya), (xb, yb) = lane[-6], lane[-1]
path.append((xb + 100.0,
             yb + 100.0 * (yb - ya) / (xb - xa), z0))
car.reroute(path)
# speed: v0 -> 6 m/s before the arc, 6 m/s on it, 6 -> 12 m/s
car.timing = timing           # v_of(s) integrated at 5 Hz
car.frame_attrs = [((0, 125), {'lyft_category': 'car'})]
